newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Parents mull sale of Sui Chong control.
newsitem.headline: Parents mull sale of Sui Chong control.

text.p: Sui Chong Holdings Ltd said on Thursday its majority shareholders Winfoong International Ltd and Hong Fok Corp Ltd were in talks to sell their aggregate 74.5 percent stake in the company.

"They were in negotiations with an independent third party for the disposal by the majority shareholders of about 74.5 percent of the existing issued share capital of the company beneficially owned by them," Sui Chong said in a statement.
"The parties are still under active negotiations but no agreement has been reached and the negotiations may or may not proceed," the statement said.

"If any agreement shall be reached, it would result in a change in control in the company and the purchaser would be obliged to extend a general offer in respect of the shares of the company," it said.
Sui Chong said it would make an announcement on the progress of the negotiations as and when apppropriate.
Hong Fok beneficially owns 40.6 percent of Winfoong.
Sui Chong shares were up HK$0.20 at HKK$1.40 in early trade on Thursday.
